extracted.name: Deviled Egg Salad
extracted.description: With its creamy, rich texture and bold taste, this deviled egg salad recipe is a versatile option for sandwiches, wraps, or a low-carb salad topping.
instruction_lines: Combine mayonnaise, green onion, mustard, salt, garlic powder, paprika, and black pepper in a bowl until smooth. Add eggs; gently stir until coated in mayonnaise mixture.
